tips: Approach steaming shallow pools to refill water before dehydration sets in.
Volcanic ash storms cut visibility—build a basic shelter early.
Stay clear of red meteor impact rings; fresh impacts often leave Primordial Crystals.
Body temperature spikes near lava rivers. Equip a Heat Shield when crossing rifts.
Toxic volcanic gas gathers near active craters—watch your oxygen gauge closely.
Place Fast-Travel Beacons in distant biomes to jump across the 4 km primordial map.

onboarding.slide1Body: No plants, no animals, no other humans exist yet. Only bare basalt plains, steaming shallow oceans, sulfur vents, obsidian fields, meteor showers, and active volcanoes across a 4 km world.
onboarding.slide2Body: Desktop: WASD move, Mouse orbit camera, Space jump, Shift sprint, E interact, I inventory, B build, M map, J journal, F3 debug. Mobile: multi-touch joystick & action buttons in portrait or landscape.
onboarding.slide3Body: Track Health, Stamina, Body Temp, Oxygen, Hydration, Radiation, and Fatigue. Progress through 5 Tech Tiers from stone tools to Archean synthesis and the Seed of Life.
onboarding.slide4Body: PRIMORDIA detected your hardware and selected a balanced graphics preset for smooth 3D playback. Adaptive quality will protect your framerate automatically.

j_basalt.title: Hadean Basalt Crust
j_basalt.body: Solidified mafic lava plains forming Earth's earliest stable continental shields.

j_ocean.title: Steaming Archean Shallows
j_ocean.body: Warm, iron-rich early oceans beneath an atmosphere thick with CO2 and water vapor.

j_volcano.title: Mount Hadean Shield Caldera
j_volcano.body: Hyper-active mantle plume venting continuous basaltic lava and sulfur dioxide.

j_sulfur.title: Sulfur Fumarole Flats
j_sulfur.body: Geothermal vents releasing dense H2S and SO2 clouds; requires Gas Filters for extended stays.

j_obsidian.title: Volcanic Obsidian Glass
j_obsidian.body: Rapidly quenched rhyolitic magma producing razor-sharp volcanic glass blades.

j_geyser.title: Hydrothermal Geyser Basin
j_geyser.body: Mineral-rich hot springs precipitating thermal salts—the cradle for prebiotic chemistry.

j_crater.title: Crystal Impact Crater
j_crater.body: High-pressure shock metamorphism fused silicates into luminescent Primordial Crystals.

j_meteor.title: Late Heavy Bombardment Scar
j_meteor.body: Nickel-iron meteorite fragments emitting mild residual cosmic radiation.

j_crystal.title: Primordial Crystal Resonance
j_crystal.body: Piezo-luminescent lattice capable of powering Teleportation Beacons and Research Stations.

j_meteor_iron.title: Extraterrestrial Nickel-Iron
j_meteor_iron.body: Dense asteroid alloy forged off-world, far tougher than terrestrial basalt.

j_thermal_salt.title: Evaporite Thermal Salts
j_thermal_salt.body: Catalytic mineral salts essential for burn treatment and prebiotic lipid synthesis.

j_quake.title: Primordial Tectonic Tremor
j_quake.body: Thin early crust fractures violently under intense mantle convection.

j_ash_storm.title: Pyroclastic Ash Storm
j_ash_storm.body: Fine abrasive tephra suspended in fierce thermal winds, coating thermal suits.

j_acid_rain.title: Sulfuric Acid Precipitation
j_acid_rain.body: Volcanic aerosols condense into corrosive rain; shelter prevents chemical burns.
